Palette limited strictly to warm cream HEX F4E8D5 on the towel and robe, warm gray HEX D4CFC4 on the concrete and porcelain, cool teal cyan HEX 00D9FF only on the lens glint and the tiny internal LED, deep matte dark HEX 050709 in the interior shadow of the opened holder, muted skin tones on the woman with slightly cool color grade for continuity with part one, no other saturated colors anywhere in the frame, no reds no greens no purples. At the very bottom left corner at the same margin the Spy brand mark placeholder is reserved at 60 pixel height for the reference logo which the model composites from the attached reference file.
